verdict: PASS
findings: []
integration:
  interfaces: create_app still imports FastAPI inside the factory and registers POST /api/backlog and POST /api/needs with a JSON object body and no query parameters. Those handlers pass the body to Reader.write_backlog and Reader.write_needs, which dismiss an open backlog item and clear an open Needs-you item. The snapshot then omits them. GET /openapi.json is FastAPI's default schema route on that app. tests/test_web_fastapi_writes.py drives all three through create_app (test_r1_backlog_dismiss, test_r2_needs_clear, test_r3_openapi).
  assumptions: Compared the worktree dashboard/web/app.py with main by reading both files. The only application change is deletion of `from __future__ import annotations`; the POST handler bodies are unchanged. The new test module is the three frozen node ids. Reader, the snapshot filters, and the dismiss/backlog helpers are unchanged in this phase and are what make a successful write disappear from the snapshot.
  invariants: fastapi is imported only inside create_app (FastAPI, Query, Request, responses, StaticFiles). write_needs returns reader.write_needs(body) and write_backlog returns reader.write_backlog(body). Both hold.
  conflicts: empty
